column1: # verdict_words.tsv -- the words that make a recorded reaction a VERDICT on a
# visit (DGN-2120 v2 §4.2 verdicts liked|neutral|disliked). Read by
# event.reaction. Rule-based, no embeddings: a clause becomes a verdict only
# when its words say so; anything else gets no verdict and only its ref is
# kept ("재밌었음" is about the evening, not the food -> no verdict).
#   taste    a word about the food itself; stands alone
#   eval     a general evaluation word; counts only when the same clause
#            also carries an anchor word, the venue name, or a kinds.tsv word
#   anchor   names the food / the place ("음식", "맛", "가게" ...)
#   negate   flips liked <-> disliked in the clause ("안 좋았") -- checked
#   group    the clause is the whole party's verdict ("다들 좋았대")
